posts.title: We Are Holding Our Own — The Wreck of the Edmund Fitzgerald, Read by Jyotiṣa
posts.description: A Jyotiṣa reading of the wreck of 10 November 1975. posts.title: The Color, Not the Flower: Dyeing White Cotton with Saffron, Turmeric and Rose Hips
posts.description: A dyer’s essay. White cotton through a saffron bath, step by step — scour, myrobalan, alum, a covered steep and a bath that never boils — then what changes for turmeric, which wants heat and hates alkali, and for rose hips, whose scarlet stays in the shell.
